extracted.intended_audience: romance writers, RWA members, prospective judges and mentors
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational standards and role expectations published by the Romance Writers of America for members, mentors, and award judges — covering judge qualifications, mentorship duties, non-discrimination policy, program submission types, and basic election procedural requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Golden Heart/Diamond Heart judge qualifications
rubrics_metrics.description: “We’re seeking experienced readers and professionals with a passion for happily-ever-afters, a commitment to fair and thoughtful critiques, and a willingness to uphold RWA’s core values.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Context: Sign up to judge the Golden Heart and Diamond Heart Awards to help recognize excellence in both published and unpublished romance. Implied expectations: experience reading/editing, demonstrable professionalism, ability to provide fair, thoughtful critiques, and adherence to the organization's values when evaluating entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: RAMP mentor responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: “RAMP mentors help prepublished writers polish manuscripts, prepare submissions, and build their confidence.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Context: Part of the Romance Author Mentorship Program (RAMP) to 'Lift Up the Next Generation of Romance Authors.' Implied criteria for mentors: provide substantive manuscript feedback, assist with submission preparation, and support mentees' professional development and confidence-building.

rubrics_metrics.name: RWA non-discrimination and anti-harassment policy
rubrics_metrics.description: “RWA is committed to providing all of its members with an environment free from discrimination and harassment. RWA does not discriminate against or allow harassment of any member based on race, ethnicity, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity or expression, ancestry, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by law. In order to create a safe and respectful environment, discrimination and harassment of any sort is prohibited in RWA.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an organizational behavioral standard governing membership, events, judging, mentoring, and all RWA activities. Implies enforcement expectations and that participants must adhere to inclusive, non-discriminatory conduct; upholding these standards is part of being eligible for roles such as judge or mentor.

rubrics_metrics.name: RWA University content submission types
rubrics_metrics.description: “Have a tip, guide, or workshop idea to share with romance writers? Submit your Author Survival Guides, Writing for Writers Guides, 2-Minute Tips, or Workshop proposals to RWA University today.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied acceptance criteria: submissions should fit one of the listed formats (Author Survival Guides, Writing for Writers Guides, 2-Minute Tips, Workshop proposals) and be useful to romance writers. Specific format, length, and content requirements are referenced (click logo for details) but not detailed on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Board candidate declaration requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: “Members interested in running for a Board position must declare their intent to run by completing and electronically submitting an Election Certification Form, by June 23, 2025.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural eligibility requirement for RWA governance candidacy — a hard deadline and a required form for candidacy. Implies that failure to submit the form by the deadline disqualifies candidacy; further questions may be submitted via the CONTACT US form.
